titles.romaji: Bakumatsu Rock: Mystery! Onsen Kaijiken ze yo!!
titles.native: 幕末Rock 湯煙推理劇[ミステリー]! 温泉怪事件ぜよ!!

description:
Unaired OVA bundled with the game Bakumatsu Rock: Ultra Soul.

An incident has led to someone's death at Teradaya, which the gang went to for a day trip. A "69" on the victim's leg will be the key to solving the mystery.

(Source: MAL News)
